description: Generate a complete nginx site config (a conf.d / sites-available file) for a reverse proxy, a static site, a single-page app (try_files fallback to index.html), a PHP-FPM site or a whole-domain redirect. Options: HTTPS with Let's Encrypt or custom certificate paths and the Mozilla intermediate TLS profile, an HTTP to HTTPS redirect, www to apex (or apex to www) redirects in one hop, http2 on or legacy listen ... http2, HSTS and security headers, gzip, WebSocket upgrades, load balancing across several backends (upstream block with keepalive, round robin / least_conn / ip_hash), a per-IP rate limit, client_max_body_size, timeouts, IPv6, per-site logs, dotfile blocking and static asset caching. Returns the config, a suggested filename, warnings and the certbot / nginx -t commands to run. Generates text only; nothing is executed.

cacheAssets.description: static/spa/php: long caching for CSS/JS/images/fonts (default true)

certificate.description: Certificate chain path (default Let's Encrypt fullchain.pem)

certificateKey.description: Private key path (default Let's Encrypt privkey.pem)

http2.description: "on" = http2 on; (nginx 1.25.1+), "legacy" = listen 443 ssl http2 (default on)

logs.description: Per-site access and error logs (default true)

rateLimit.description: Requests per second per client IP, 0 = off (default 0)

redirectTo.description: redirect: target URL, path and query are kept

securityHeaders.description: nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, server_tokens off (default true)

serverName.description: Host name(s), space or comma separated, e.g. "example.com www.example.com"; "_" is the catch-all

timeout.description: reverse-proxy/php read and send timeout in seconds (default 60)

upstream.description: reverse-proxy: backend(s) such as http://127.0.0.1:3000, 10.0.0.5:8080 or unix:/run/app.sock; several for load balancing (default http://127.0.0.1:3000)

wwwRedirect.description: Redirect between apex and www (default none)

name: generate_nginx_config
